regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your number of favors I've failed to acknowledge. What about that trip to Huntington and of course to St. Felix ?..... I just received Doris' letter giving me your phone number. Please God I'll call you Sunday Evening about 7:45. We are to have a chapter in Detroit July 11-14 We do not know as yet who is to go thither. Please help us to storm Heaven for guidance of the Holy Ghost.
